name: standard file resource in node
source: configuration Example { Node localhost { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = "C:\Temp"; Ensure = "Present" } } }

name: resource keyword names and braces across newlines
source:
configuration Example { Node
localhost
{ File
ExampleFile
{ DestinationPath = "C:\Temp" } } }

name: resource instance generic names keep dollar fragments literal
node target is one complete member operand
source: configuration Example { Node $AllNodes.NodeName { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } } }

name: node target expressions return arrays
source: configuration Example { Node @("one", "two") { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } } }

name: node target comma needs grouping
source: configuration Example { Node one,two { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } } }

name: property key quotes and nested hashtables retain fields
source: configuration Example { File ExampleFile { "DestinationPath" = $path; Contents = @{ Key = "value"; Other = 1 } } }

name: property value can be a nested resource statement
source: configuration Example { File Parent { DestinationPath = "C:\Parent"; DependsOn = File Child { DestinationPath = "C:\Child" } } }

name: ordinary control flow retains resource statements
source: configuration Example { foreach ($name in @("one", "two")) { if ($name) { File $name { DestinationPath = $name } } } }

name: configuration helper function sees standard keywords
source: configuration Example { function Create-File { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } }; Create-File }

name: script resource property bags restore ordinary command names
source: configuration Example { Script ExampleScript { GetScript = { File first; Node second; Import-DscResource third }; TestScript = { $true }; SetScript = { Write-Output done } }; File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } }

name: script resource property value expressions keep ordinary syntax
source: configuration Example { Script ExampleScript { GetScript = $(File first); TestScript = (File second); SetScript = @{ Key = File third } } }

name: resource comments and pipeline property values
source: configuration Example { File <#name#> ExampleFile <#body#> { Contents = Get-Content <#source#> $path | Out-String; DestinationPath = $target } }

name: import resource statement preserves command elements
source: configuration Example { Import-DscResource -ModuleName PSDesiredStateConfiguration -Name File,Script; Node localhost { File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path } } }

name: import resource module hashtable argument
source: configuration Example { Import-DscResource -ModuleName @{ModuleName="PSDesiredStateConfiguration";ModuleVersion="1.1"}; File ExampleFile { DestinationPath=$path } }

name: meta configuration settings have no instance name
source: [DscLocalConfigurationManager()] configuration Example { Node localhost { Settings { RefreshMode = "Push"; ConfigurationMode = "ApplyAndMonitor" } } }

name: meta resource declaration has an instance name
source: [DscLocalConfigurationManager()] configuration Example { Node localhost { ConfigurationRepositoryWeb PullServer { ServerURL = "https://example.test/dsc"; RegistrationKey = $key } } }

name: settings must not have an instance name
import keyword cannot start a pipeline
resource instance names permit a variable
resource instance names forbid two words
quoted resource keyword is an ordinary expression
native invocation bypasses resource keyword interpretation
resource names outside configuration remain commands
source: File ExampleFile { DestinationPath = $path }; Node localhost {}; Script ExampleScript {}; Import-DscResource -Name File

name: node filtered collection target
source: configuration Example { Node $AllNodes.Where{ $_.Role -eq "Web" }.NodeName { File Website { DestinationPath = $path } } }

name: comments after declaration bodies retain parent ranges
source: configuration Example { Node localhost { File A {DestinationPath=$path} <#between#> File B {DestinationPath=$path} } <#tail#> }

name: malformed resource property preserves next command
source: configuration Example { File A { DestinationPath = }; Write-Output after | next }

name: resource statement inside collected property expression
source: configuration Example { File Outer { Contents = "$(File Inner { Contents = `"value`" })" } }

name: script reset also applies to collected expressions
source: configuration Example { Script ExampleScript { GetScript = { "$(File Inner {})" }; TestScript = { $true }; SetScript = { Write-Output done } } }

name: resource pipeline property value retains interpolation
source: configuration Example { Node localhost { File A { Contents = "$(Get-Content $path | Out-String)" } } }
